dct_title_s: Surface Water Features - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains rivers and ponds that occur in Newton. Boston Edison (now known as NSTAR) provided the original version of this data layer. Some editing was done based on the 2000 Orthophotography by the GIS Administrator.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to hydrology, environmental management, urban planning or to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on urban planning and policies, public works, or utilities purposes, including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational or non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
Data credit: GIS data supplied by City of Newton GIS.
